problem_type: Interactive canvas import outlives its originating project
symptom: Capacity/dimensions/upload completion or retry writes after project replacement
direct_cause: Async preparation captures global project too late and retry stores files without originating lifetime
class_root: Project IO authority for an action was self-captured wherever each helper remembered to (or defaulted late after awaits) instead of being issued once at the action entry by the owner of window + project identity
affected_population: Node and reference slot file uploads
Global screenshot hotkey capture and crop panel
Video frame and shot-cut extraction to canvas
internal_only_reason: Nomi coordinator hydration ownership, main session binding and global canvas store boundaries define the invariant; no new third-party API.
invariants: Capture full project binding before asynchronous preparation
Replacement permanently revokes old interactive actions, including A to B to A
Same-project page navigation preserves action identity
Cancelled operations cannot recover or persist data URLs

Renderer project IO authority is issued only by projectCanvasReadSurface (withProjectAction / withMainProjectAction); the capture is module-private and every downstream helper requires the issued context

Main-started actions (global screenshot hotkey) fix the committed surface binding and asset write context before their first await; the renderer adopts the action only while that exact binding is current
Interactive main IO requests carry the issued binding and join the trusted session before any await; explicit background IO still fixes disk identity before its long step

door_reduction.why_not: The authority doors were merged: self-capture went from 20 committed call sites (31 with the in-flight branch work) to 0 outside projectCanvasReadSurface, and every remaining withProjectAction/withMainProjectAction row is a distinct user or main-started action entry that only receives the issued context. The other rows are consumers that must exist separately (typed ProjectExecutionContext parameters, lifetime checks, shared importers and the main-side session join) and cannot self-issue.

generality_proof: There is no longer a way to obtain project IO authority except at an issuance point: the renderer capture is module-private (compile error on import), shared helpers take a required context (compile error when forgotten, pinned by @ts-expect-error in projectActionIssuance.contract.test.ts under check:test-types), and the AST scan in the same test rejects issuance after an await, optional or nullable context parameters/properties and any private issuer reference anywhere in src. Main-started actions reuse the canvas read surface registry epoch capture plus captureAssetWriteContext instead of a renderer-reported id. Explicit background asset IO remains bound to its original project through its separately owned storage identity.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own project action lifetime independently of short-lived transport fields
Require originating context across preparation, upload, recovery and node writes
Single renderer issuance point for project IO authority; withMainProjectAction adopts main-started actions only for the exact current binding
Main-side session join for interactive import and frame IPC before any await
Fix committed surface epoch and asset write context before desktopCapturer; re-assert before publication and notification

prevention.invariant: Only the originating project lifetime may publish an interactive import to the canvas
prevention.failure_mode: Project replacement or cancellation terminates without further IO, canvas mutation, retry, fallback or rejected UI promise
prevention.strategy: Single issuance point (module-private capture, required context parameters, AST and @ts-expect-error class tests) propagated to main session IO; main-started actions bind the registry epoch before awaits

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove unbound upload metadata and retry state; delete the exported self-capture and coordinator capture method, persistNodeImage default contexts, clip/image-upload/import/clipboard optional-context late fallbacks, importClipNodeAsset duplicate projectId parameter, and the nomi:screenshot:set-project renderer-reported project id channel (setScreenshotProjectId/currentProjectIdForCapture, preload/bridge setProjectId)

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Uses existing coordinator, store and importer

migration: No persisted schema changes; in-memory retries die with their project lifetime.
residual_risks: Real Electron drag/paste/screenshot project-switch journeys are not run in this code-convergence step (second step).

Id-level current-project reads remain outside the issuance point (census of 97 getActiveWorkbenchProjectId/getDesktopActiveProjectId sites): interactive late reads in director persistOutputs, useDecomposeLayers, ClipNode export apply, timeline drops, deleteAssetResult via NodeResultStack, WorkflowLibraryContent, journeyTourStore, useAgentPanelSpendConfirm, browser overlay/popover windows; background generation re-reads in catalogTaskActions and recoverTaskActions and taskApi overriding extras.projectId. Background runs need a run-owned project identity decision; other windows need their own issuance owner.
assetUploadApi.resolveProjectId still falls back to the current project for callers without a binding (resultUrlRelocalizeBridge, importAudioToLibrary when projectId is null).

invariant_owner_layer.rationale: Structure converged: projectCanvasReadSurface is the only renderer issuer of project IO authority (window + project key); helpers cannot self-capture (module visibility) or forget the context (required types); the class test pins issuance timing. Main-started and main IO paths bind the registry epoch / session before awaits.
